419ddeefa6d996afed4d.en: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°. 40° + 75° = 115°, so the third angle is 180° - 115° = 65°.
419ddeefa6d996afed4d.id: Jumlah sudut segitiga adalah 180°. 40° + 75° = 115°, jadi sudut ketiga adalah 180° - 115° = 65°.

a566e5821fc3fad424ee.en: The triangle has a base of 10 cm and a height of 10 cm. Its area is 10 × 10 ÷ 2 = 50 cm², half of the square.
a566e5821fc3fad424ee.id: Segitiga itu punya alas 10 cm dan tinggi 10 cm. Luasnya 10 × 10 ÷ 2 = 50 cm², yaitu setengah dari persegi.

0a1466d0e479f9430865.en: In the top row the right part is 18 ÷ 12 = 1.5 times the left part, because they share a height. The bottom row has the same widths, so the bottom right is 20 × 1.5 = 30 cm².
0a1466d0e479f9430865.id: Di baris atas, bagian kanan 18 ÷ 12 = 1.5 kali bagian kiri, karena tingginya sama. Baris bawah punya lebar yang sama, jadi kanan bawah 20 × 1.5 = 30 cm².

382eea9155bb60b02a8d.en: Top row: same height, so the areas compare like the widths.
382eea9155bb60b02a8d.id: Baris atas: tingginya sama, jadi perbandingan luasnya sama dengan perbandingan lebarnya.

46b61f61523d0b5d3f1f.en: Bottom row: same widths as the top.
46b61f61523d0b5d3f1f.id: Baris bawah: lebarnya sama dengan baris atas.

c991173423317c17b937.en: A hexagon splits into 4 triangles, so its angles add up to 4 × 180° = 720°. Shared equally by 6 angles, each is 720° ÷ 6 = 120°.
c991173423317c17b937.id: Segi enam (hexagon) terbagi menjadi 4 segitiga, jadi jumlah sudutnya 4 × 180° = 720°. Dibagi rata untuk 6 sudut, masing-masing 720° ÷ 6 = 120°.

5d3c38bcefa86985f7f6.en: Triangles inside a hexagon from one corner.
5d3c38bcefa86985f7f6.id: Segitiga di dalam segi enam dari satu titik sudut.

ccb99735c1384fd79cc0.en: The three different faces have areas 4 × 3 = 12, 4 × 2 = 8 and 3 × 2 = 6. Each appears twice, so the total is 2 × (12 + 8 + 6) = 52 cm².
ccb99735c1384fd79cc0.id: Tiga sisi yang berbeda punya luas 4 × 3 = 12, 4 × 2 = 8, dan 3 × 2 = 6. Masing-masing muncul dua kali, jadi totalnya 2 × (12 + 8 + 6) = 52 cm².

2fff20b723174555575d.id: Setiap sisi punya pasangan yang sama.

77ee58901916c2130906.en: Length + width = 20 cm. Taking away the difference of 4 leaves 16, so the width is 8 cm and the length is 12 cm. The area is 12 × 8 = 96 cm².
77ee58901916c2130906.id: Panjang + lebar = 20 cm. Kalau selisih 4 diambil, sisanya 16, jadi lebarnya 8 cm dan panjangnya 12 cm. Luasnya 12 × 8 = 96 cm².

2961eaf807dae9f22dee.en: From 12, the minute hand is at 8 × 30° = 240°. The hour hand is at 3 × 30° + 20° = 110°. The angle between them is 240° - 110° = 130°.
2961eaf807dae9f22dee.id: Dari angka 12, jarum menit ada di 8 × 30° = 240°. Jarum jam ada di 3 × 30° + 20° = 110°. Sudut di antara keduanya 240° - 110° = 130°.

f120499618013e5256d7.en: The perimeter is 3 × 16 = 48 cm. Each side of the square is 48 ÷ 4 = 12 cm, so its area is 12 × 12 = 144 cm².
f120499618013e5256d7.id: Kelilingnya 3 × 16 = 48 cm. Setiap sisi persegi 48 ÷ 4 = 12 cm, jadi luasnya 12 × 12 = 144 cm².

d8b9dc7e15d3e7e99acc.en: Each side is 36 ÷ 4 = 9 cm. The area is 9 × 9 = 81 cm².

8280592114240925e38a.en: Not 36. That is the perimeter. Area is the side length times itself.
8280592114240925e38a.id: Bukan 36. Itu kelilingnya. Luas adalah panjang sisi dikali panjang sisi itu sendiri.

76c4bbccff6f709e215f.en: 6 triangles make 6 × 180 = 1080°. A regular octagon has 8 equal angles, so each is 1080 ÷ 8 = 135°.
76c4bbccff6f709e215f.id: 6 segitiga menghasilkan 6 × 180 = 1080°. Segi delapan beraturan punya 8 sudut yang sama besar, jadi masing-masing 1080 ÷ 8 = 135°.

eb45ee6f674be2ab26d4.en: A regular octagon has 8 equal angles, so each is 1080 ÷ 8 = 135°.
eb45ee6f674be2ab26d4.id: Segi delapan beraturan punya 8 sudut yang sama besar, jadi masing-masing 1080 ÷ 8 = 135°.

dbad7e3b07689e5ebc98.en: Not 108. That is the angle in a regular pentagon.
dbad7e3b07689e5ebc98.id: Bukan 108. Itu sudut pada segi lima beraturan.

8eebb13ab4c5a8a08d30.en: The triangle has base 12 cm and height 8 cm. Its area is 12 × 8 ÷ 2 = 48 cm², half of the rectangle.
8eebb13ab4c5a8a08d30.id: Segitiga itu punya alas 12 cm dan tinggi 8 cm. Luasnya 12 × 8 ÷ 2 = 48 cm², yaitu setengah dari persegi panjang.

302ad41ebf0f005b28d1.en: Each triangle has area 3 × 3 ÷ 2 = 4.5 cm². Four triangles make 18 cm². The shape that is left has area 100 - 18 = 82 cm².
302ad41ebf0f005b28d1.id: Setiap segitiga punya luas 3 × 3 ÷ 2 = 4.5 cm². Empat segitiga menghasilkan 18 cm². Bangun yang tersisa punya luas 100 - 18 = 82 cm².

05e8c4b5ecbb75b13f7c.en: The shape that is left has area 100 - 18 = 82 cm².
05e8c4b5ecbb75b13f7c.id: Bangun yang tersisa punya luas 100 - 18 = 82 cm².

cdb7525d0c1bbdee3fcb.en: Not 64. You may have cut off whole squares of 3 cm by 3 cm. Each cut is a triangle, half of a square.
cdb7525d0c1bbdee3fcb.id: Bukan 64. Mungkin kamu memotong persegi utuh berukuran 3 cm kali 3 cm. Setiap potongan berupa segitiga, yaitu setengah persegi.

d20c55280b7e7023134b.en: Each of the 12 edges has 3 small cubes. The 2 at the ends are corners. So 1 middle cube on each edge has exactly two red faces: 12 cubes.
d20c55280b7e7023134b.id: Masing-masing dari 12 rusuk punya 3 kubus kecil. 2 kubus di ujung adalah pojok. Jadi 1 kubus tengah di setiap rusuk punya tepat dua sisi merah: 12 kubus.

1e05bfcaa38396b3cafc.en: The small rectangles are 10 cm by 6 cm. The perimeter is 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32 cm.
1e05bfcaa38396b3cafc.id: Persegi panjang kecil berukuran 10 cm kali 6 cm. Kelilingnya 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32 cm.

121bff4ea7785a4e6312.en: The angles are 1 part, 2 parts and 2 parts, which is 5 parts in total. 180 ÷ 5 = 36, so the third angle is 36°.
121bff4ea7785a4e6312.id: Sudut-sudutnya 1 bagian, 2 bagian, dan 2 bagian, jadi totalnya 5 bagian. 180 ÷ 5 = 36, jadi sudut ketiga 36°.

fa44fedd7d26f062d9ea.en: The angles are 1 part, 2 parts and 2 parts, which is 5 parts in total.
fa44fedd7d26f062d9ea.id: Sudut-sudutnya 1 bagian, 2 bagian, dan 2 bagian, jadi totalnya 5 bagian.

93bf5de6663b628568e5.en: With the path the rectangle is 12 m by 10 m, area 120 m². The garden is 10 × 8 = 80 m². The path is 120 - 80 = 40 m².
93bf5de6663b628568e5.id: Dengan jalan setapak, persegi panjangnya 12 m kali 10 m, luasnya 120 m². Luas kebun 10 × 8 = 80 m². Luas jalan setapak 120 - 80 = 40 m².

38513c59404dbc14c6b7.en: With the path the rectangle is 12 m by 10 m, area 120 m².
38513c59404dbc14c6b7.id: Dengan jalan setapak, persegi panjangnya 12 m kali 10 m, luasnya 120 m².

b4c877ecb9384114fdf7.en: Both rectangles are 8 cm long. 2 × (8 + w) = 28 gives w = 6. The other rectangle has width 8 - 6 = 2 and area 8 × 2 = 16 cm².
b4c877ecb9384114fdf7.id: Kedua persegi panjang punya panjang 8 cm. 2 × (8 + w) = 28 menghasilkan w = 6. Persegi panjang yang lain punya lebar 8 - 6 = 2 dan luas 8 × 2 = 16 cm².

daa0536169f24064cc30.id: Kedua persegi panjang punya panjang 8 cm.

6cae1b3dd821bc1f4e49.en: The other rectangle has width 8 - 6 = 2 and area 8 × 2 = 16 cm².
6cae1b3dd821bc1f4e49.id: Persegi panjang yang lain punya lebar 8 - 6 = 2 dan luas 8 × 2 = 16 cm².
